method: Read the12 frozen natural-language questions and derive supported hard constraints before reading the sidecar. Then compare all12 mappings. No filters inferred from expected answers, source-target labels or observed new-dataset retrieval scores.
exposure_disclosure: Reviewer read repository README orientation and knew historical development-set results. No first frozen12-case benchmark measurement existed or was run. Later boundary probes used explicitly relabelled fixtures, never newly measured retrieval.
limitations: Explicit typed user inputs; no automatic natural-language filter extraction is claimed.
Unsupported requirements remain in the natural question and must not be presented as enforced.
Same five known fictional documents; no unseen-corpus or unseen-intent generalization claim.
Filtering may remove textual exclusion evidence needed for comparison; source-evidence completeness can decrease.

cases.decision: Indoor is an explicit hard condition. Starting exactly14:00 is not a whole-activity availability interval. Free participation/material provision remain in the question, not invented filter fields.
Friday600–840 is the full-activity availability window. Outdoor is explicitly a soft preference and must not become a filter.
Sunday is an explicit required scheduled day.
Tuesday840–960 is the complete-activity window. Paid work is unsupported and remains a question condition. Bicycle repair is an interest, not a hard activity identifier.
Questions about experience, fluent Dutch, guidance, tools and clothing do not supply supported hard day/environment/window filters.
Wheelchair accessibility is a hard but unsupported requirement; retain unknown handling. Requested time/place/length are information requests, not availability filters.
Sesame avoidance is a hard but unsupported requirement. Do not pretend to enforce allergens through environment/day/time filters.
Wednesday describes the named cafe, rather than requested user availability. Arabic support and transport are unsupported fields.
Historical capacity comparison/date does not supply a supported hard activity filter.
Outdoor and fully finished before11:00 are hard constraints. Minute-resolution inclusive end659 matches that requirement; unlike a start-before11 request, this constrains activity completion.
The activity referent is missing. No typed filter can be inferred safely.
Vegetables/flowers versus bicycle repair identifies the question topic, not a hard supported day/environment/window constraint.
